{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Golden equipment''' is crafted from [[Gold Ingot|gold ingots]]. Each piece carries an intrinsic: golden tools have [[Fortune]] I, golden weapons [[Looting]], and golden armor [[Fire Protection]].

== Obtaining ==
Gold ingots come from [[Native Gold|native gold]], which needs an iron pickaxe, and from [[Gilded Hellstone|gilded hellstone]]. The golden helmet is named the [[Golden Crown|golden crown]].

== Mining ==
Golden tools mine fast (speed 12, or 15 for the shovel) but break quickly. Unlike vanilla, the golden pickaxe harvests every ore; only obsidian gives no drops.
